an5.201:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kimbilāyaṃ viharati, niceluvane.
an5.201:1.2: atha kho āyasmā kimbilo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā kimbilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an5.201:1.3: ‘ko nu kho bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti’.
an5.201:1.4: idha kimbila, tathāgate parinibbute bhikkhu bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari agāravā viharanti appatissā. dhamme agāravā viharanti appatissā, saṅghe agāravā viharanti appatissā, sikkhāya agāravā viharanti appatissā, aññamaññaṃ agāravā viharanti appatissā.
an5.201:1.5: ayaṃ kho kimbila, hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
an5.201:2.1: ko pana bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
an5.201:2.2: idha kimbila, tathāgate parinibbute bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari sagāravā viharanti sappatissā. dhamme sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, saṅghe sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, sikkhāya sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, aññamaññaṃ sagāravā viharanti sappatissā.
an5.201:2.3: ayaṃ kho kimbila, hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotī’ti.
